---
title: "Budget and Revenue" 
---

@fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between movie budgets and the revenue made. 

::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
# generate the dataset 
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(df["budget_musd"],df["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget in MUSD")
plt.ylabel("Revenue in MUSD")
plt.show()
```
